title: Linked List Cycle Detection
description:
Implement a simple `Node` class and a function `has_cycle(head)` that detects if a linked list has a cycle using Floyd's Tortoise and Hare algorithm.

The `Node` class should have `val` and `next` attributes. The function should return `True` if there is a cycle, `False` otherwise.
hint: Use two pointers: slow moves 1 step, fast moves 2 steps. If they meet, there's a cycle.
outputExplanation: Floyd's algorithm uses O(1) extra space. The slow and fast pointers will meet inside the cycle if one exists.

tests.name: Has cycle
tests.input:
n1 = Node(1)
n2 = Node(2)
n3 = Node(3)
n1.next = n2
n2.next = n3
n3.next = n1
print(has_cycle(n1))

tests.name: No cycle
tests.input:
n1 = Node(1)
n2 = Node(2)
n1.next = n2
print(has_cycle(n1))
